subject: Ozzy Osbourne
headline: one year after ozzy osbourne's death, tributes continue
body: kelly osbourne wrote a letter to her late father, and black sabbath's surviving members paid tribute too.
slide2: "i feel you in the quiet, in the wind, in every song that stops me in my tracks," she wrote.
quote: i feel you in the quiet, in the wind, in every song that stops me in my tracks

subject: Adam Driver
headline: adam driver keeps turning down marvel movies
body: kevin feige says it's basically a tradition at this point.
slide2: "it's a tradition to zoom with him and then he passes," feige joked on the happy sad confused podcast.

subject: Olivia Rodrigo
headline: olivia rodrigo has a new name for anti-abortionists
body: she sat down with the center for reproductive rights to talk about the issue.
slide2: "pro-control" is what she called anti-abortion advocates during the conversation.

subject: Seth MacFarlane
headline: seth macfarlane is voicing two characters in stewie
body: the family guy spinoff just locked its full voice cast.
slide2: kenan thompson, vanessa bayer, melissa o'neil and mike henry round out the cast — henry voices someone tied to one of his classic family guy characters.
